case_presets.label: Young 2021 coupled-humidity 1-hour diagnostic
case_presets.evidence_context: Loads the Young 2021 coupled-humidity package and a 1-hour conditional diagnostic. The configured phases determine how many complete cycles or tails occur inside the fixed one-hour horizon; it is not convergence, CSS, or humid-cycle validation.

case_presets.label: Direct steam · Lewatit (1 h)
case_presets.evidence_context: One-hour wet-bed diagnostic at 75% RH with 10 kg/h maximum steam. Phase-transfer, drainage and wet sorption are assumptions. The short horizon includes initial stored CO2.

case.label: Direct steam on humid Lewatit, 1 h

case_presets.label: Young 2021 hot 116 C conditional preview, dry 48 h
